To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the marketing management bases are as important as the environmental bases for international market segmentations and (2) the environmental and the marketing management bases complement each other.
(1) the marketing management bases are important bases for international market segmenta.

(1) international market segmentation based on environmental and marketing management variables results in a higher level of segmentation than segmentation based only on environmental variables; (2) the number of segments is not affected by whether the marketing management or the environmental variables are used; and (3) the number of marketing management variables that are used in the segmentation procedure has a significant effect on the level of segmentation.
